title: Fix TypeScript strict-mode errors in stealth instrument

comments.content: Delivered: fixed all 165 TypeScript strict-mode errors in the stealth instrument (instrument.ts 98, index.ts 62, error.ts 5) under the real TS6 toolchain. Pushed feat/stealth-js-instrument-v2 + chore/crosslink-config; retargeted PR bases to make the stack a structural invariant (#1195→#1214→#1154).
